vote.summary: The candidate is internally consistent, covers the material architecture options and rollout decisions, translates retained unknowns into measured gates, and does not overclaim destination-level capacity. I found no in-scope acceptance criterion, required detail, or material objection unsatisfied by this version.
requirements_covered: Decide a durable AI job architecture without depending on a second broker before measured PostgreSQL limits are crossed
Decouple AI job execution from API request lifecycles so ticket CRUD health is independent of LLM health
Define a durable Postgres data model with idempotency, leases, events, safe error vocabulary, and reconciliation indexes
Specify admission, duplicate handling, status/event retrieval, and recovery across API/worker restarts
Specify worker lifecycle with SKIP LOCKED claims, lease renewal, conditional commit, at-least-once delivery, and safe cancellation semantics
Specify total per-artifact external-call budget, retry classification, shared circuit breaker, and approved-fallback constraints
Specify approved model registry, route snapshots, exact-reuse and cache rules, and prompt/token budget controls
Provide a bootstrap capacity model with load inputs, conservative ceiling formula, headroom, and worker scaling conditions
Provide measurable SLO/release gates, telemetry and alerting, verification matrix, phased rollout, rollback, and stop conditions
implementation_options: A then B: harden/instrument the current single-scheduler request-bound path only for Phase 0, then adopt Postgres durable jobs plus async workers
B now, C later: use PostgreSQL as durable queue/lease source of truth; add a broker only after measured thresholds and via transactional outbox
B + advisory LISTEN/NOTIFY: Postgres NOTIFY as best-effort wake-up only, with polling and leases authoritative
D: application-owned task-aware provider policy with approved registry, shared circuits, route-level budget, and approved secondary routes
C deferred: managed broker/queue rejected initially and re-evaluated only on measured triggers
E rejected/deferred: self-hosted inference withheld until a separate regulatory/residency or sustained-utilization decision proves the case
D + E deferred: hosted-primary/self-hosted fallback rejected until equivalent quality, approval, capacity, and operations are proven
details_checked: ai_jobs/ai_job_events schema, partial indexes, idempotency key composition, tenant scope derivation, and 30-day terminal retention
Admission transaction, active-job/exact-artifact duplicate return, NOTIFY advisory failure tolerance, 202 + Retry-After response, and status/event APIs
Postgres claim/lease/conditional-commit race handling, lease expiry reclaim, stale-write discard, and worker drain behavior
Total three-call budget and explicit LLMManager attempt-limit refactor, retry/do-not-retry classes, and circuit open/cooldown/half-open/close thresholds
Route registry, non-secret route snapshot at admission, exact-reuse identity checks, no semantic caching, and tenant-safe prompt caching conditions
Capacity formula units and 20% headroom, p75 conservative inputs, burst validation, and worker scale conditions bound by shared provider caps
Broker/outbox triggers and rejection of Redis Pub/Sub or plain-list as durable queue
SLO gates, telemetry privacy, paging criteria, verification matrix, migration phases, rollback/drain runbooks, and stop conditions
vote.proposed_artifact: No revision proposed; accept the canonical v0 text as the decision record.
